task: I will arrive Pittsburgh Airport soon. Provide the name of the Hilton hotel closest to the airport. Then, tell me the the walking time to the nearest supermarket from the hotel.
answer:
FINAL: Hilton Garden Inn Pittsburgh Airport, 9600 University Boulevard, Moon Township, is the closest Hilton hotel to Pittsburgh International Airport.

The nearest supermarket is Pittsburgh Area Commissary at 79 Soldiers Lane: Google Maps gives an 8-minute walk (0.4 mile) via Soldiers Lane. It requires military shopping eligibility, and Maps marks the route as restricted/private.

For a supermarket open to the general public, Walmart Supercenter at 7500 University Boulevard is the nearest option found: a 26-minute walk (1.2 miles) via University Boulevard.

Evidence checked October 27, 2026:
- Hotel distance comparison: https://pitinternationalairport.com/pittsburgh-international-airport-hotels/ lists Hilton Garden Inn ahead of Hampton Inn and DoubleTree.
- Walking route shown in final.png: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hilton+Garden+Inn+Pittsburgh+Airport,+9600+University+Blvd,+Moon+Township+PA&destination=Pittsburgh+Area+Commissary,+79+Soldiers+Lane,+Moon+Township+PA&travelmode=walking&hl=en
- Commissary access: https://corp.commissaries.com/shopping/store-locations/pittsburgh-area states “100% Military ID check is in effect.”
- Public alternative route: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hilton+Garden+Inn+Pittsburgh+Airport,+9600+University+Blvd,+Moon+Township+PA&destination=Walmart+Supercenter,+7500+University+Boulevard,+Moon+Township+PA&travelmode=walking&hl=en
- Walmart's grocery department: https://www.walmart.com/store/4644-moon-township-pa
